Silent NO head shake: columns face slightly left, centered, slightly right. Stern closed lips throughout. Talking columns: closed lips, partly open speech mouth, open speech mouth. Silent columns follow the explicit gesture progression with closed lips. All panels aligned, equal head size, entire hair and shoulders visible, no cropping hands/props. Target emotion must stay visibly distinct across all six frames. No adult face, no text, no labels.
IMPORTANT: This set is SILENT. All SIX mouths closed; do not follow mouth-opening sequence of reference 2. Show clearly different HEAD ROTATIONS across columns as specified.
